final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mostly reframed the same record in narrower terms. That narrowing is useful as characterization, but it does not cure the unresolved compliance predicate. The admissible evidence still shows a 1.4 percentage point miss in a named launch use case tied to lender commitments, an open legal review on disclosure, and no approved risk acceptance. Under the stated policy, that leaves the disclosure requirement unsatisfied on the present record. A caveated certification defense may describe business or launch-readiness posture, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is itself an unresolved policy condition rather than a disclosed, bounded residual risk.
remaining_concerns: The loan modification support segment still misses target and is a named launch use case in two lender rollout commitments, which supports materiality under the policy text.
The admissible record still contains no final legal determination on whether the gap must be disclosed.
The admissible record still contains no approved risk acceptance covering this named launch use case before launch.
Aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the separate disclosure predicate for a material limitation.
General model-card and risk-management guidance supports documentation and monitoring, but does not override or satisfy the specific release policy requirement.
